name: fill-documents
description: Fill local HWP, HWPX, DOCX and PDF templates with supplied facts.

interface.longDescription: Fill Documents by yback provides 16 local templates for letters, reports, meeting minutes and applications in HWP, HWPX, DOCX and PDF. The skill inventories applicable writing areas and requires completion and review; the bundled CLI fills supported explicit fields and preserves the original file. Version 0.2.0 adds controlled long-content flow and completion-coverage reporting. Unmarked or complex forms require document-specific preparation and review. Arbitrary rewriting of completed documents, general partial editing, scanned PDFs and normal PDF body editing are not supported. Node.js 20 or later is required. No separate server, API key or in-product payment is needed. Native Hancom Office and Microsoft Word rendering has not been verified.

review.commerce_description: Free, open-source software with no in-product payments or purchases.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0 adds controlled long-content flow for supported HWP, HWPX, DOCX and PDF structures, whole-document completion instructions, coverage reporting and DOCX tab-stop preservation. General completed-document rewriting and partial editing remain unsupported.

ko-KR.description: yback의 Fill Documents는 공문·보고서·회의록·신청서 16종을 HWP·HWPX·DOCX·PDF로 제공합니다. 스킬은 모든 적용 작성란을 조사하고 작성·검수하도록 지시하며, 포함된 CLI는 지원되는 명시적 필드를 채우고 원본을 보존합니다. 0.2.0에는 제한된 장문 이어쓰기와 작성 범위 보고를 추가했습니다. 표식 없는 빈칸과 복잡한 서식은 문서별 준비·편집·검수가 필요합니다. 완성본의 범용 재작성·부분 편집, 스캔 PDF와 일반 PDF 본문 편집은 지원하지 않습니다. Node.js 20 이상이 필요하며 별도 서버·API 키·제품 내 결제가 없습니다. 한컴오피스와 Microsoft Word 자체 앱의 표시는 미검증입니다.
